PROJECT.ONLOAD: SELECT si.SktInventuraGlaId, si.DatumDok as [Datum dokumenta], si.DatumPopisa as [Datum popisa], s.Opis as Skladište , kl.Naziv as Klasifikacija FROM sktinventuragla si INNER JOIN Skladiste s ON s.SkladisteId = si.SkladisteId left outer join KlMasterRoba kl on kl.KlMasterRobaId = si.KlMasterRobaId WHERE si.Status = 0 and si.DatumDok > '20150101'
PROJECT.DETAILGRID: ;WITH popis AS ( SELECT ce.robaid, ISNULL(ce.kkvalglaid,0) AS kkvalglaid, SUM(ce.kolicina) AS kolicina FROM InventuraCE ce GROUP BY ce.RobaId, ISNULL(ce.kkvalglaid,0) ) select sd.SktInventuraDetId, r.UserId as Šifra, r.Naziv as Roba , kg.broj, kg.Opis, kg.RokTrajanja , sd.KolicinaKnjizna as [Kolicina;Knjižna], sd.KolicinaStvarna as [Kolicina;Stvarna] , i.kolicina as [Kolicina;Terminal], sd.KolicinaKnjizna - i.kolicina as Razlika FROM sktinventuradet sd INNER JOIN popis i ON i.RobaId = sd.RobaId AND ISNULL(sd.KKvalGlaId,0) = i.kkvalglaid inner join roba r on r.RobaId = sd.RobaId left outer join KKvalGla kg on kg.KKvalGlaId = sd.KKvalGlaId WHERE sd.SktInventuraGlaId = @@ID
